'''Oldranai''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Daluuj/Legends|Daluuj]].<ref name="LECG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Oldranai was mentioned in the ''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]'', a roleplaying game sourcebook published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] in [[2009]].<ref name="LECG" />
